data.title: Measuring Angles with a Protractor
data.description: Practice placing and reading a virtual protractor to find the exact degree measure of various drawn angles.

challenges.narration: The hands of a clock opens to this angle.
challenges.instruction: Place the protractor on the angle and read its measure.
challenges.hint: Line up the protractor’s center on the vertex and its baseline on one ray. Read where the other ray crosses the scale.
